postinstall: # BUG-N135 (task #948): mask tmp.mount so /tmp stays on the root disk instead
# of a RAM tmpfs (~2GB on a 4GB VM). Backstop to the spagat-console DB + scratch
# moving to /var; prevents any /tmp writer from exhausting RAM (No space left).
# BUG-N147.f1 (task #978): enable logrotate.timer so the spagat-bridges rule
# (shipped via the overlay at /etc/logrotate.d/spagat-bridges) actually runs.
# Photon's logrotate RPM ships the timer but %systemd_post does NOT enable it,
# and the appliance has no cronie, so bridge-aa.log on /var/spagat/bridges would
# never rotate without this. Enabled explicitly rather than relying on a preset.

printf '[Match]
Name=eth0 en*

[Network]
Address={{ INSTALL_STATIC_IP }}
Gateway=192.168.225.2
DNS=192.168.225.2
' > /etc/systemd/network/10-eth0-static.network

_SPAGAT_OPERATOR_AUTHORIZED_KEY='{{ SPAGAT_OPERATOR_AUTHORIZED_KEY }}'; if [ -n "$_SPAGAT_OPERATOR_AUTHORIZED_KEY" ]; then printf '%s
' "$_SPAGAT_OPERATOR_AUTHORIZED_KEY" > /home/operator/.ssh/authorized_keys; else : > /home/operator/.ssh/authorized_keys; fi

_WIZARD_PRESEED_TOML_B64='{{ WIZARD_PRESEED_TOML_B64 }}'; if [ -n "$_WIZARD_PRESEED_TOML_B64" ]; then printf '%s' "$_WIZARD_PRESEED_TOML_B64" | base64 -d > /etc/spagat/appliance-config.toml && chmod 0640 /etc/spagat/appliance-config.toml && chown root:spagat /etc/spagat/appliance-config.toml; fi

_WIZARD_COMPLETE_MARKER='{{ WIZARD_COMPLETE_MARKER }}'; if [ "$_WIZARD_COMPLETE_MARKER" = "1" ]; then : > /var/spagat/state/wizard-complete && chmod 0644 /var/spagat/state/wizard-complete && chown root:root /var/spagat/state/wizard-complete; fi
